Subject: New White Paper: IDC Reports: Gain Better Control of Processes and Costs with Document Process Automation

Dear SearchSAP.com member,

Enterprises know their volumes of customer orders but have a hard
time identifying the total cost of their current process. If you
can't measure the costs, you can't control them either. Document
process automation helps to identify costs, so that they can then be
optimized.

Read this IDC paper to learn the benefits of automating key document
processes including a reduction in the number of errors, time
savings, and financial gain. Explore how you can reduce the use of
paper in company communication.

Click here to learn more:
http://go.techtarget.com/r/3070420/2079970
